title: Library Refuge
flavor: A dry roof, free WiFi, and no closing time on the patience — the books are always working. You show up, the library holds its ground.

title: Farmers Market Work
flavor: Saturday morning on 8th — real people, real soil under their nails, real food that took actual work. You're part of the transaction, not just the transaction.

title: Morning Ground
flavor: The parks open at dawn when the city sleeps and you've already won something—no meetings, no phone, no excuses, just you and the path.
predicate: (sv) => sv.place?.poiType === 'park' && sv.sun?.goldenHour === true && sv.self?.stepCount > 3000 && sv.weather?.fog !== true

title: Gym Ritual
flavor: Doors open at 5 AM. No ego, no theater — just people moving their bodies the same way they move their lives. Resistance, then rest. Repeat.

title: Riverside Clarity
flavor: Blue hour at the water's edge — the light's honest now, no heat, no glare. Just the current doing its work. You stand there and remember the river was here first.
predicate: (sv) => sv.place?.nearWater === true && sv.sun?.blueHour === true && sv.weather?.precipMm < 2 && sv.weather?.fog !== true && sv.time.hour >= 17 && sv.time.hour < 21

title: Storm's Wake
flavor: The rain stopped; the air is clean and the earth breathing—sit where the water pooled and listen.
predicate: sv.weather != null && sv.weather.petrichor === true && sv.weather.cloudCover < 40 && sv.weather.snowing === false && sv.weather.precipMm > 2

title: Checking In
flavor: Tuesday dusk at the park: show up, sit, be counted among the people who make a place feel lived-in.
predicate: sv.place != null && (sv.place.poiType === 'library' || sv.place.poiType === 'community_center' || sv.place.poiType === 'park') && sv.sun?.twilightPhase === 'civil' && sv.time.dayOfWeek >= 1 && sv.time.dayOfWeek <= 5

title: Water's Edge at Dusk
flavor: The Willamette holds the golden hour like a mirror, and there's a bench somewhere on its bank with your name on it.

title: Riverside Twilight Walk
flavor: Blue hour, riverside path, your body moving—the world slows to walking speed and you remember why that matters.
